fullContentHtml:
UPPSC PCS 2025 Interview Schedule - Complete Details

Short Information : Uttar Pradesh Public Service Commission (UPPSC) has released the interview schedule for the Combined State Upper Subordinate Services Examination 2025. This recruitment was released for 210 posts. Applications for the UPPSC Pre Recruitment 2025 were accepted from February 20, 2025, to April 02, 2025. The interview examination s going to conducted on 28 September 2026 to 24 October 2026. Candidates who have applied for this mains form can download their UPPSC PCS Interview Schedule 2026 from the link given below..

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 20 February 2025
  • Last Date : 02 April 2025
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 02 April 2025
  • Correction Last Date : 09 April 2025
  • Exam Date : 12 October 2025
  • Admit Card : 30 September 2025
  • Answer Key : 18 October 2025
  • Result : 01 December 2025
  • Mains Exam Date : 29 March To 01 April 2026
  • Mains Admit Card : 21 March 2026
  • ACF / RFO Main Exam Date : 14-28 July 2026
  • ACF / RFO Main Admit Card : 08 July 2026
  • Mains Exam Result : 17 September 2026
  • Interview Schedule : 28 September 2026 to 24 October 2026

Application Fee

  • General, OBC, EWS : Rs. 125/-
  • SC, ST : Rs. 65/-
  • PH : Rs. 25/-
  • The candidate can pay the fee through online via Credit Card / Debit Card Or Net Banking or through SBI Challan.
